description: Ransomware leak-site victim listings: who a group claims to have hit, when, sector, country. These are claims by the groups, not confirmed breaches. Returns the newest listings matching the filters plus a tally of every listing in the window by group, sector and country, so 'most active group' and 'most hit sector' questions are answered from the tally, not the sample. Use for any question about ransomware victims, a group's activity, or a sector / country being hit. 2 credits (listings + tally).

days.description: window in days (free keys: up to 7)

group.description: ransomware group name, e.g. qilin, akira, lockbit5

sector.description: e.g. Healthcare, Education, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Government

victim.description: substring of a victim organisation name or domain (matched client-side over the newest listings)

name: leak_site_victims
title: Ransomware leak-site victims
